recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31811 unless BR&R later reopens the policy question of moving manufacturer information fully to SubstanceDefinition.
issue_request: FHIR-31811 was a Published BR&R change request for R5. The final Persuasive with Modification resolution kept manufacturer on Ingredient but required Ingredient.manufacturer to become a 0..* backbone with a 1..1 manufacturer Organization reference and an optional 0..1 role code with a required binding.
initial_application: The issue was previously applied by explicit FHIR#31811 commits: 90626a2640 changed Ingredient.manufacturer to a backbone with role and manufacturer children; 72c7bcfe69 and 464b98e6e7 added the approved multi-case definition text; ec0ce86256 corrected Ingredient.manufacturer.role from Coding to code and corrected the value set description.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows Ingredient is active in the current core build, assigned to BR&R, and is the current successor for MedicinalProductIngredient. BR&R Confluence minutes show FHIR-31811 was continued on 2021-09-28 and considered/resolved on 2021-09-30. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the latest combined-branch source already has Ingredient.manufacturer as a 0..* BackboneElement, Ingredient.manufacturer.role as a 0..1 code with required binding to ValueSet/ingredient-manufacturer-role, Ingredient.manufacturer.manufacturer as a 1..1 Reference(Organization), and the manufacturer search parameter expression on Ingredient.manufacturer.manufacturer.

evidence_items.learned: The final decision kept manufacturer on Ingredient but changed its shape and semantics to distinguish allowed, possible, and actual manufacturer relationships.
